title: Open Harness Protocol - Journal Entry Schema
description: Schema for each line in the append-only journal.jsonl ledger.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the iteration entry.

hypothesis.description: The specific falsifiable hypothesis tested in this iteration.

scope.description: Declared reach of the change: invariant (must hold for every case) or local (valid only for the declared cases).

deficiency.description: Named behavior class the candidate targeted, e.g. planning, tool-use, context-management, delegation, knowledge, procedure, constraint, reliability, cost.

cases.description: Declared evaluation inputs this iteration was probed against.

harness_fingerprint.description: Exact harness state that produced this result (RFC-0009 HOP-11).

contrast.description: Behavioral verdict against the target deficiency, relative to the reference execution.

cost.description: Measured cost of this iteration, when available.

evidence_ref.description: Reference to the receipt or artifact supporting the decision.

promote_global.description: Declares intent to treat local evidence as a global default. A conforming validator rejects this, because local evidence does not establish a global claim.

failure.description: Diagnosis of why this iteration did not achieve its declared effect (RFC-0014).

detail.description: The observation that supports the class.

decision_ref.description: Reference identifier to the immutable record in decisions/ (e.g., 'D-190').

rationale.description: Empirical explanation for the adoption, rejection, or findings.
